title: Arizona Action Rentals
specs: 2021 Sea-Doo GTI SE 170 jet skis with 170 HP, capable of 55+ mph speeds
Jet skis have brakes, mirrors, Variable Trim System, boarding ladder, and wide-angle mirrors
Each ski can carry up to 3 riders or 600 pounds
Includes iBR® (Intelligent Brake & Reverse) for better control
Primary renter must be 21 or older with valid driver’s license
Operator age minimum 16 years; kids can be passengers but not operators
Must have vehicle capable of towing 3,000 pounds with Class 2 or higher hitch and 2" ball
All passengers must be physically able to pull themselves back on jet ski if they fall off

blurb: Guests rent two Sea-Doo GTI SE 170 jet skis on a trailer to haul to approved Arizona lakes. Rentals include life vests, safety kits, waterproof phone cases, dry bags, extra fuel cans, and other necessary equipment. The skis have adjustable speed modes and can carry up to 3 riders or 600 pounds each.
